Desc_TW:
未竟之境：一筆未收，一舞未停，一界未成。

當繪畫走出畫框，走進的不只是虛擬空間，更是藝術家的內在宇宙。梵谷重新定義了色彩如何承載情感，讓後印象派走向了表現主義的門檻；馬諦斯用一生的時間，證明線條與色塊本身就能構成完整的世界，開啟了繪畫中的野獸派；丘爾利歐尼斯則在西方藝術史還沒有「抽象」這個詞之前，就已經把音樂的結構畫進了畫布。三人在各自藝術史的轉折點上，留下了後人繞不開的位置。
Desc_EN:
A World Still Becoming: One brushstroke never set down, one dance never stopped, one world never finished.

When a painting steps outside its frame, what it enters is never just a virtual space — it is the artist's own inner cosmos. Van Gogh redefined how colour could carry emotion, pushing Post-Impressionism to the threshold of Expressionism. Matisse spent a lifetime proving that line and colour alone could build a complete world, opening the door to Fauvism. Čiurlionis, before the West even had a word for ""abstraction,"" was already painting the structure of music onto canvas, and stands among Europe's earliest pioneers of abstract art and visual music. Separated by generations and borders, all three left a mark on art history that no one after them could paint around.

Desc_TW:
本單元以「國美館典藏」及「臺灣藝術家經典作品」為選片核心。
執行團隊透過精選的重要圖像、裝置與影像創作，發展對應的 VR／沉浸式體驗內容，落實讓觀眾在虛擬空間中重新進入與感受經典作品的美學與脈絡。
此一策展執行方向旨在凸顯國內藝術創作能量與館藏價值，並透過數位轉譯與沉浸式詮釋，建立具在地文化根基的常態節目庫，確立 VR 藝廊與國美館的品牌核心辨識。
Desc_EN:
The selection core of this section focuses on the "NTMoFA Collection" and "Classic Works by Taiwanese Artists." 

We aime to develop corresponding VR and immersive experience content through selected significant images, installations, and video creations. This approach allows audiences to re-enter and perceive the aesthetics and context of these classic works within a virtual space.
 This curatorial direction aims to highlight domestic artistic creative energy and the value of the museum's collection. Through digital translation and immersive interpretation, it seeks to establish a regular program library grounded in local culture, solidifying the core identity that closely links the VR Gallery with the National Taiwan Museum of Fine Arts brand.

Title_TW: 逐浪之翼：荷蘭沉浸式內容特別展演
Title_EN: Wings and Waves: A Special Showcase of Dutch Immersive Content
Desc_TW: 本次展演從生態、氣候變遷、歷史記憶與殖民遺緒出發，透過兩件作品截然不同的視覺風格與敘事方式，帶領觀眾從沉浸式體驗中，思考人與環境、歷史及未來之間的關係。
Desc_EN: Wings and Waves is a special showcase of Dutch immersive content at the VR Gallery. Bringing together two Dutch VR works, the programme considers ecological crisis, colonial history, opening a space for audiences in Taiwan and the Netherlands to reflect on nature and history.

Desc_TW: 梵谷最喜歡的黃色，是向日葵的黃，是麥田的黃，也是南法陽光的顏色。透過嘉舍醫生之女瑪格麗特的聲音，我們隨著這名年輕女子，走入梵谷私人醫師——嘉舍醫生的起居室，這裡曾經迴盪著鋼琴的樂聲，一張張老照片，帶我們走入梵谷的生命記憶。
Desc_EN: On July 29th, 1890, in Auvers-sur-Oise, the painter Vincent van Gogh died by suicide. Marguerite, the daughter of his physician, Dr. Gachet, was one of his last models. The experience starts in the home of Dr. Gachet, where Marguerite reminisces about the artist. She takes the viewer on a journey through his palette of colours and famous works: in Provence, where he nearly lost himself in his quest for the “high yellow note”; the reds and greens of the cafés along the Rhône River; the vivid colours of the night sky; and in the fields of Northern France, where he explored the pure colours of exhilaration and passion.

Desc_TW: 1906 年至 1954 年間，亨利馬諦斯創作了 20 多幅以「舞蹈」為主題的畫作。這個主題形塑了他的藝術取向，深刻影響其風格和技法。對這位色彩大師而言，律動與舞蹈是他終其一生的靈感泉源。《舞動舞動馬諦斯》是一場沉浸式的舞蹈之旅，邀請觀眾親身進入馬諦斯的藝術世界，參與由舞蹈家莎拉席佛布拉特布瑟所創作的舞蹈。
Desc_EN: Henri MATISSE created over 20 paintings exploring the theme of dance. This subject shaped many of his artistic choices, influencing his style and technique. Movement and dance were constant sources of inspiration for the master of color throughout his lifelong work. An immersive, dance-led journey through MATISSE's most iconic works, Dance Dance Dance – Matisse invites viewers to step inside his world. Featuring original choreography by Sarah SILVERBLATT-BUSER, in which the user takes part, the experience pays tribute to the vibrant movements and colors that define his art. This journey into dance and painting grants an intimate view into the creation of some of his greatest masterpieces.

Image_EN_PC: 眾界創生 直式海報英.png
Desc_TW: 立陶宛畫家兼作曲家丘爾利歐尼斯，一生關注的從來不是塵世瑣事，而是永恆本身。他畫的創世組畫，融合了聖經敘事、星雲宇宙觀與東方宇宙論，卻始終沒有畫完人類誕生的那一天——十三幅畫停在第五日，把最後一步，留給了每一個走進去的人。體驗尾聲，你會從旁觀者，變成這個尚未完成的世界的守護者。
Desc_EN: Lithuanian painter and composer Mikalojus Konstantinas Čiurlionis was never drawn to the trivial matters of earthly life, but to eternity itself. His creation cycle fuses biblical narrative, nebular cosmology, and Eastern cosmological thought — yet never completes the day humanity was made. The thirteen paintings stop at the fifth day, leaving the final step to whoever walks in. By journey's end, you move from bystander to guardian of a world still unmade.

Desc_TW: 一隻數位蝴蝶領著觀眾，穿越由手繪色塊、童稚意象與希望故事交織而成的世界。作品觸及生態崩壞、難民處境、消費主義與氣候變遷，邀請觀眾重新發現這個世界，並在其中種下來自過去的種籽，滋養一個仍值得期待的共同未來。這是一段緩慢而感性的旅程：美與感受先行，意義則在後方慢慢浮現；沉浸式技術在此成為一種先被感受、再被理解的語言。
Desc_EN: A digital butterfly guides visitors through a layered world of vivid drawings, childlike imagery and hopeful storytelling. Moving through ecological collapse, displacement, consumerism and climate change, the work invites us to look again at the world and to plant seeds from the past for a shared future. It is a gentle and emotional journey in which beauty and feeling arrive before explanation, allowing meaning to emerge gradually.

Desc_TW:
《奇蹟之籃》用祖父講述童年往事的方式，帶觀眾走進人類近代的一段歷史。故事裡，一個看似「錯誤」的決定，卻意外促成了改變，也為地球的未來留下一絲希望。

作品把西方文明的到來，描繪成純真時代畫下句點的那一刻，並透過這段敘事，將歷史記憶與當代的環境危機、社會抗爭串連起來，讓觀眾重新思考人與自然、人與社會之間的關係。
Desc_EN: The Miracle Basket is A VR journey that gives a glimpse into humankind’s recent past told through an intimate childhood story in which mistakes bring change and hope for the future of the planet. By describing the arrival of the west as the downfall of innocence, the VR experience relates to environmental issues of today and political uprising through storytelling.

Desc_TW: 這部 17 分鐘的 VR 作品以諷刺筆調展開，場景設定在一座虛構的未來博物館，館內供奉著十七世紀荷蘭東印度公司（VOC）探險家亞伯．塔斯曼（Abel Tasman）。當荷蘭逐漸沒入上升的海平面，塔斯曼被復活為民族英雄，肩負一項新的殖民任務：為荷蘭氣候難民尋找新的土地。作品以檔案影像、AI 生成畫面、2D 動畫與流行文化符號拼貼而成，在戲謔與荒誕之中，追問殖民神話、氣候災難、假訊息，以及我們繼承且持續複製的權力結構。每位觀眾的體驗路徑皆不相同。
Desc_EN: This 17-minute satirical VR work unfolds in a fictional museum of the future dedicated to seventeenth-century Dutch VOC explorer Abel Tasman. As the Netherlands sinks beneath rising seas, Tasman is resurrected as a national hero and given a new colonial assignment: to find land for Dutch climate refugees. Combining archival material, AI-generated footage, 2D animation and pop-culture references, the work probes colonial myth-making, climate catastrophe, misinformation, and the structures of power we inherit and continue to reproduce. Each visitor follows a different path through the experience.

Desc_TW: 由八個獨特的房間所構成，觀者置身於象徵「記憶」的黑板所構成的虛擬世界中，任意翱翔，探索文字、圖像、符號、聲音與記憶的各種線索。
Desc_EN: La Camera Insabbiata Composed of eight unique rooms, the visitors are placed in a virtual world made up of blackboards that symbolize "memory," where they can freely soar and explore various clues of words, images, symbols, sounds, and memories.

Desc_TW: 思鄉之情裊裊，神往之情依依，經由科技重新詮釋郭雪湖先生美學的《望鄉三態》，釋放禁錮的時空、打破永恆的靜態，讓思鄉之情再度流轉。
Desc_EN: Homesickness and longing were reinterpret into Kuo's aesthetic painting Three States of Home Gazing through technology. Set free the confined time and space, break the eternal state and let the homesickness flow again.

Desc_TW: 從大眾消費文化整合世代記憶的創作品，將共同的卡漫角色記憶分析色彩，喚起集體視覺記憶的當代藝術作品，充滿趣味。進而透過這視覺色彩記憶、大眾之間的符碼，進行記憶的交換，建構色彩記憶資料庫。
Desc_EN: Integrating Pop Culture and Generational Memory Through Color and Character. These contemporary artworks draw from the visual language of mass consumer culture, analyzing the colors of familiar cartoon characters to evoke collective visual memories. Playful and engaging, the works transform shared nostalgia into a dialogue of signs and symbols, enabling an exchange of memories among the public. Through this process, a color-based memory archive is gradually constructed.

Title_TW: 凝視臺灣的山水與本土風行開創水墨現代化
Title_EN: Gazing Upon Taiwan's Landscape and Local Life—Pioneering the Modernization of Ink painting

Image_EN_PC: 常態片單-凝視台灣的山水.jpg
Desc_TW: 影片中可看見席德進早年受到西方現代藝術的啟發，呈現西方現代思潮如普普藝術和歐普藝術的影響，創作出民間的門神、新年、廟宇、窗櫺的藝術題材，具有真實的情感流露。
Desc_EN: In this video, viewers can witness how Shiy De-jinn was inspired by Western modern art in his early years. Influences from movements such as Pop Art and Op Art are evident in his work, as he turned to local subjects like door gods, Lunar New Year celebrations, temples, and traditional window lattices. These themes are portrayed with striking authenticity and emotional resonance, reflecting a deeply personal and cultural expression.

Desc_TW: 走入劉其偉童趣而不羈的意識世界，從童年蟲魚鳥獸的色彩啟蒙，到他退休後所投入的藝術創作，甚至是田野的冒險，都呈現在畫家親筆畫作所構築的一方天地。
Desc_EN: Enter the whimsical and untamed realm of Max Liu’s imagination. From the vibrant creatures of his childhood insects, fish, birds, and beasts to the artistic explorations he pursued after retirement, and even his adventurous field journeys, this exhibition unveils a world constructed through the artist’s own hand-drawn works. Each piece offers a glimpse into the playful yet boundless consciousness of a painter who never ceased to explore.

Title_TW: 無價之畫：巴黎的追光少年
Desc_TW: 昭和時期，台灣藝壇正式展覽平台有限，對懷抱藝術夢想的年輕創作者而言，機會寥寥可數 。楊三郎仍舊懷抱成為藝術家的夢想。在一次台展（臺灣美術展覽會）落選後，楊三郎感到沮喪與挫折 。1932年7月，他與畫家劉啟祥一同離開台灣前往法國，希望能重新找到自己的繪畫價值 。他們先抵達馬賽，隨後轉往巴黎，在歐洲藝術中心繼續追尋藝術熱情與深造之路 。
Desc_EN: The Showa period held few opportunities for aspiring artists in Taiwan, where formal exhibition platforms remained limited. Yet the young Yang San-lang still dreamed of becoming one. After being rejected in a bid to be shown in the Taiwan Art Exhibition (Taiten), Yang San-lang was left sad and frustrated. He left Taiwan for France in July 1932, traveling with fellow painter Liu Chi-hsiang, where he hoped to rediscover his artistic path. Arriving first in Marseille before heading to Paris, Yang pursued his passion and continued his artistic training in the heart of the European art world.

Desc_TW:
公視以林玉山〈蓮池〉為藍本，全新製作 VR 互動影片《窺見生命的奧妙》，運用 4K 超高畫質技術重現〈蓮池〉的生態世界。
 影片透過不同生物之間的視角轉換，帶領觀眾走入大師的作品之中，深入體會這位台灣畫壇大師當年從天黑守到天亮，直到「親眼目睹」荷花綻放、並「窺見生命的奧妙」時，心中湧現的感動。
Desc_EN:
Based on Lin Yu-shan’s painting Lotus Pond, The Taiwan Public Television Service has created a new VR interactive video titled Lin Yu-shan: Sketching Lotus Pond—A Glimpse into the Mysteries of Life.

Using 4K ultra-high-definition technology, the video recreates the ecological world of Lotus Pond.
Through the perspective shifts between different creatures, it guides viewers into the master's work, allowing them to deeply experience the emotions felt by this giant of Taiwanese painting when he waited from dusk till dawn to "witness" the lotus flowers bloom and "glimpse the mysteries of life."
